description: This file defines a custom exception class `AcknowledgementCorrelationIdMissingException` used in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.acks.base package. It represents an error condition when an acknowledgement message lacks a required correlation-id header. The class includes methods for creating an instance from JSON and a builder class for construction.

classes.name: AcknowledgementCorrelationIdMissingException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException that indicates a missing correlation-id in an acknowledgement message.

classes.name: AcknowledgementCorrelationIdMissingException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of AcknowledgementCorrelationIdMissingException, with a fluent API.

methods.name: AcknowledgementCorrelationIdMissingException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: AcknowledgementCorrelationIdMissingException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the exception with specified headers.

methods.name: Builder.doBuild
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance with provided details.
